description: This source file defines the Entity Framework Core DbContext implementation for the Conduit project, including DbSet properties for entities, model configuration, and transaction handling.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: Entity Framework Core DbContext for managing database operations related to the Conduit domain entities, with configuration for entity relationships and transaction management.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Overrides the base method to configure entity relationships and keys using Fluent API.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction unless one is already active, skipping if using in-memory database.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current database transaction if active, with rollback on failure.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rollback the current transaction if active.
